workflow_runs.name: Check
workflow_runs.display_title: portal: model completed deletion in force retry tests

head_commit.message:
portal: model completed deletion in force retry tests

Remove each force-retry fixture journal before its fake command
reports success, matching the deletion completion side effect. Prove
fresh reconciliation preserves the completed receipt and retry
identity. A retained matching journal must still pause a completed
receipt without changing its identity.

workflow_runs.name: Check
workflow_runs.display_title: portal: check reconciliation deadline after proof

head_commit.message:
portal: check reconciliation deadline after proof

Check the caller's original context after journal and response proof, before
accepting lifecycle reconciliation. Slow proof must not commit authority after
the fresh-owner deadline has expired.

Keep the upstream contention retry and acceptance behavior, and extract its
loop for deterministic progress-conflict, cancellation and no-op coverage.

workflow_runs.name: Check
workflow_runs.display_title: cluster: mediate capture leases through the generation guard

head_commit.message:
cluster: mediate capture leases through the generation guard

Relay capture-lease input, readiness and diagnostics through dispatcher-owned
pipes. Retain the selected package-generation guard through provider exit and
reaping, and cancel the owned child when the caller or protocol is lost.

Close the downstream protocol pipe promptly on provider stdout EOF, even if
that provider is still running. Diagnostic stderr closure leaves the lease
usable. Other provider commands retain buffered dispatch and exit behavior.

workflow_runs.name: Check
workflow_runs.display_title: kb: add an optional managed cluster provider

head_commit.message:
kb: add an optional managed cluster provider

Enable the provider when siteConfig.clusterDefaults.kb is configured.
Delegate lifecycle operations to the pinned standalone engine and use its
matching read validators for owned snapshots. Preserve creation provenance
across compatible package transitions.

Route capture leases through public dispatch, translating only the managed
descriptor digest. Removal inventory avoids recursively locking the session;
omitting KB defaults retains the existing provider set.
